title: सारङ्गी बोकेको समुद्र कवितामा बिम्बविधान
nepali: मोहन कोइरालाको 'सारङ्गी बोकेको समुद्र’ कृतिमा अन्तर्निहित बिम्बात्मक प्रयोगको पहिचान गर्नु नै यस अध्ययनको उद्देश्य हो । यही उद्देश्यलाई पूरा गर्नका लागि प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा उल्लिखित कृतिभित्र प्रयुक्त बिम्बहरूको प्रकृति खोजी गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनलाई पूर्णता दिनका लागि पुस्तकालयीय कार्यबाट सामग्रीको सब्कलन गरिएको छ भने सामग्री विश्लेषणका लागि बिम्ब विश्लेषणका सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणाहरू प्रस्तुत गरी तिनीहरूमध्ये यौनबिम्ब, सांस्कृतिक बिम्ब र प्राकृतिक बिम्ब गरी तीनवटा आधार तयार पारिएको छ । यी तीन आधारमा विश्लेषण गर्दा सोद्देश्यमूलक विभिन्न कविताका विशिष्ट पब्क्तिहरूलाई साक्ष्यका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यसरी अध्ययन गर्दा मोहन कोइरालाको 'सारङ्गी बोकेको समुद्र’ कृतिमा नवीन बिम्बको अधिक प्रयोग भएको पाइन्छ । यसो हुनुमा प्रयोगधर्मी कविको काव्यगत प्रवृत्ति नै मुख्य रहेको देखिन्छ । यस कृतिमा प्रयोग भएका बिम्ब कथ्य विषयसँग झिनो मात्रामा समानता राख्ने किसिमका छन् । यस्तो झिनो सम्बन्धलाई कतिपय पाठकले पहिचान गर्न नसक्ने र पहिचान गरे पनि साधारणीकरण गर्न समस्या पर्ने देखिन्छ । मोहन कोइरालाको यसै प्रवृत्तिलाई आधार मानी धेरै समालोचकले उनलाई दुरुह कविको संज्ञा पनि दिएका छन् । बिम्बहरूको अधिक प्रयोग र यस्ता बिम्बको कथ्य विषयसँगको झिनो सम्बन्ध भएबाट यस सब्ग्रहका कविता बुझ्न अलि कठिन भए पनि भाव बुझेपछि भिन्न र विशिष्ट किसिमको अर्थोद्घाटन गर्ने किसिमका छन् । यस अध्ययनबाट 'सारङ्गी बोकेको समुद्र’ कृतिभित्रका कवितामा नवीन, अप्रचलित र कथ्य विषयसँग झिनो सम्बन्ध भएका बिम्बको प्रयोग भएको र यस्तो प्रयोगका कारण यो काव्य विशिष्ट र सम्प्रेषणगत दुरुह भएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: Identifying the imagistic usage inherent in Mohan Koirala's work 'Sarangi Bokkeko Samudra' is the objective of this study. To fulfill this objective, the nature of the images used within the mentioned work has been sought in the present study. To complete this study, material has been collected through library work, while for material analysis, theoretical concepts of image analysis have been presented and among them three bases - sexual image, cultural image and natural image - have been prepared. When analyzing on these three bases, specific lines of various purposeful poems have been presented as evidence. Studying in this way, it is found that there is excessive use of novel images in Mohan Koirala's work 'Sarangi Bokkeko Samudra'. For this to be so, the poetic tendency of an experimental poet is seen to be the main factor. The images used in this work are of a kind that bear only a faint similarity to the thematic subject. It appears that some readers may not be able to identify such a faint relation, and even if they do identify it, they face difficulty in generalizing it. Taking this very tendency of Mohan Koirala as a basis, many critics have also given him the designation of an obscure poet. Because of the excessive use of images and the faint relation of such images with the thematic subject, the poems of this collection are somewhat difficult to understand, but once the sentiment is understood they are of a kind that yield a different and distinctive interpretation. From this study, the conclusion is drawn that in the poems within 'Sarangi Bokkeko Samudra' there is use of images that are novel, uncommon and faintly related to the thematic subject, and because of such usage this poetry is distinctive and communicatively obscure.

informal_english: Basically, this study's about spotting the imagery tucked away in Mohan Koirala's 'Sarangi Bokkeko Samudra'. To that end, we've looked at what kind of images the work uses. To finish the study off, I gathered material from the library, and for analysing it I set out the theory behind image analysis, picking out three bases - sexual, cultural and natural images. Using those three bases, I put forward specific lines from various purposeful poems as evidence. Doing it this way, it turns out there's a heavy use of novel images in Koirala's work. That comes down to the poetic streak of an experimental poet, really. The images in this work only faintly resemble the thematic subject. Some readers won't clock that faint link at all, and even those who do will struggle to generalise from it. On the strength of this very tendency, plenty of critics have labelled him an obscure poet. With so many images and such a faint link to the subject, the poems are a bit hard to crack, but once you grasp the feeling they open up into something different and distinctive. The upshot of the study is that the poems in 'Sarangi Bokkeko Samudra' use novel, uncommon images only faintly tied to the subject, and because of that the poetry is distinctive yet communicatively obscure.
